summary: PowerBank Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated July 30, 2026, announcing a fee-for-service agreement to support TriMac Engineering with solar feasibility studies for Victoria County, Nova Scotia. No special situation is involved; this is a routine business development announcement. The filing does not contain M&A activity, tender offers, activist campaigns, or other special-situations events. It is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer disclosing ordinary operational news.
